capabilities: Review Markdown flashcards with FSRS scheduling on desktop and mobile
Play five arcade games (Blast, Match, Hangman, Aliens, Sword) using your decks
Rate and navigate cards hands-free with a Bluetooth ring or page-turner remote
Read cards aloud with device, online, or Google Cloud text-to-speech voices
Unlock game ships, designs and weapons based on completed reviews
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and BRAT is the recommended install path. Games are practice-only and never change the FSRS schedule; the only network use is optional online text-to-speech, which sends card text to Google.
problem: Reviewing flashcards in Obsidian is awkward on a phone and impossible hands-free, since existing workflows assume a desktop, a mouse and reading with your eyes.

relations.evidence: Mobile-Translate is my other plugin. Its output builder can create new cards at the press of a button
Google Cloud Text-to-Speech with your own API key

summary: FSRS spaced repetition plugin that reviews plain-Markdown flashcards on mobile, with five arcade games, Bluetooth remote control and text-to-speech.
